aperture.observed_compliance: Only parent task messages and own scratch files were read. No repository, memory, production checker, or external case/grader/result material was read or executed.

known_limits: Synthetic author-created controls; no claim of distributional representativeness.
The bounded reference grammar is documented in followup_grade.py; it is not unrestricted semantic grading.
No experimental model calls or production-checker runs were performed. No live performance is measured.
Reference values are exact final base-unit quantities; only explicit monetary instructions produce rounded references.
Rates, percentage points, each currency, days, months, and items are distinct units; no currency or calendar conversion is inferred.
Smoke cases have separate IDs, sources, questions, and reference pairs from main cases; grammar overlap is intentional.
Source statements are entirely synthetic and do not identify real invoices, policies, or accounts.
